giving.heading: Free, because grace is free.
giving.lead: Grace BJJ costs nothing, just like God's grace. Our salvation isn't earned by anything we give (Ephesians 2:8–9), yet we're still called to give cheerfully (2 Corinthians 9:7). We ask that you give what you feel called to give, with
giving.minimum: a suggested minimum of $5 each class
giving.tail: if you're able. Every dollar goes toward mat care, equipment, and even helping keep the lights on. The more we receive, the more we're able to do. If you can't give, that's completely fine. You're just as welcome here.

kidsNote: The kids class meets on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday, 5:30–6:15 PM, right before the Tuesday adult class.
